school: 谋略学/经世之学（以'先陈后张'次第方略佐明定天下的元末明初谋士、文学家、立法者）
historical_significance: 刘伯温（1311-1375），名基，字伯温，处州青田人，元末明初谋士、文学家、思想家，'浙东四先生'之首。元末进士（1333），历高安县丞、江浙儒学副提举，因方国珍招安事与朝议不合弃官归隐；至正二十年（1360）朱元璋以金币遣使、处州总制孙炎再三相邀，聘至应天，陈'时务十八策'，太祖筑礼贤馆处之，'每召入，辄屏人密语移时'；力主'士诚自守虏不足虑、友谅劫主胁下宜先图之'的先陈后张次第，佐定龙湾（1360）、江州、鄱阳湖（1363）诸役，鄱阳湖之战中观天象请移舟而免炮石；吴元年劝正位建邦，洪武初为御史中丞兼太史令，与李善长等议定《大明律》、考定《大统历》、立卫所兵制；性刚嫉恶，'与物多忤'，与李善长、胡惟庸相继构隙，洪武四年（1371）以妻丧告老归隐青田，'惟饮酒弈棋，口不言功'；洪武八年（1375）忧愤而卒，传为胡惟庸挟医来视而鸩之，正德八年谥文成。元末弃官期间著《郁离子》二百余则寓言，以'郁离子'自况而讥切时政；诗文与宋濂并称，身后《烧饼歌》托名流传六百年——'三分天下诸葛亮，一统江山刘伯温'，民间将其神化为前知五百年后知五百载的预言家，而其本相是一位把战略时序、形势判断、立法工程、寓言批判与退出设计集于一身的'帝师型'知识分子。
historical_significance_en: Liu Bowen (1311-1375), personal name Ji, courtesy name Bowen, a native of Qingtian, Chuzhou — strategist, man of letters and thinker at the Yuan-Ming transition, first of the 'Four Worthies of Zhedong'. A Yuan jinshi (1333), he served as assistant magistrate in Gao'an and vice-intendant of schools in Jiangzhe, retiring over the Fang Guozhen amnesty dispute; in 1360 Zhu Yuanzhang sent envoys with gold and silk, with Sun Yan pressing the invitation, and he presented the Eighteen Policies on the Times, lodged in the Hall for Honoring the Worthy, conferring nightly behind closed doors; he championed the sequence 'Shi Cheng the self-guarding captive is no worry; Youliang, hostage-holder upstream, must be taken first', directing Longwan (1360), Jiangzhou and Lake Poyang (1363) — at Poyang reading the heavens and having the flagship moved out of the stone-shot's path. He urged the founding of the state in the Wu year; in early Hongwu as censor-in-chief and director of astronomy he helped draft the Great Ming Code, fix the Great Concord calendar and establish the weisuo garrison system. Stern, hating evil, 'at odds with many', he clashed with Li Shanchang and Hu Weiyong, retired to Qingtian in 1371 upon his wife's death — 'drinking wine and playing go, never speaking of merit' — and died in grief in 1375, by tradition poisoned by a physician sent by Hu Weiyong; the title Earl Wencheng came in 1508. In his late-Yuan retirement he wrote the Yulizi's two hundred allegories under the persona of Yu the Illustrious, needling the age; his prose stands with Song Lian's, and the Baked-Cake Song circulated under his name for six centuries — 'Zhuge Liang won a third of the realm; Liu Bowen won it entire', folk memory deifying him as a prophet of five hundred years past and to come, while his true face is that of an advisor-scholar fusing strategic sequencing, positional judgment, legislative engineering, allegorical critique and the design of his own exit.
unique_thinking: 刘伯温思维模式的独特性在于'把不确定性变成时序'的总体方法论：(1)决策工程化：先陈后张不是勇气而是排序算法——按'消灭谁之后全局如何变化'重排对手，用隔离设计保证每一阶段单线作战，每胜一局重算全局；(2)知识择用而用择时机：象纬之学、经史义法、兵法术数全部登记'用途'后统摄于致用，又在'不可逆行动'上专立时机工程——学为用服务，用为时服务；(3)言说与生存的双保险：寓言给批判买'虚构豁免'，辞爵归田给功业做'退出工程'，临终献书给思想开'身后通道'——进言、退身、传世三件事都当作可设计的问题解；(4)术数的人本转化：一生精于占候而终以'占之者心也，非卦也'归于人本，把神化他的民间传统反转为对占卜决定论的批判——这是他留给术数学最深的一笔遗产。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Liu Bowen's thinking lies in a total methodology of 'turning uncertainty into sequence': (1) engineering the decision: 'Chen first, Zhang second' was not boldness but a ranking algorithm — reordering rivals by 'how the board changes once each falls', designing isolation so every phase is single-front, recomputing the whole after each victory; (2) knowledge sized by use, use timed by hours: the astral arts, classical doctrine, strategy and mantic numerals were all registered for use and subsumed under service to the world, while a separate discipline of timing was built for irreversible acts — learning serves use, and use serves the hour; (3) double insurance in speech and survival: allegory buys critique 'the immunity of fiction', resigning titles builds an 'exit engineering' for one's career, the deathbed book-presentation opens a 'posthumous channel' for thought — advising, withdrawing, transmitting, each solved as a designable problem; (4) the humanist conversion of the mantic arts: a lifetime master of divination ending at 'what divines is the mind, not the hexagram', turning the folk tradition that deified him into a critique of divinatory determinism — his deepest legacy to the arts he practiced.
civilization_zh: 元末明初的浙东谋士世界：生于处州青田武阳村（1311），字伯温，元末进士（1333），历高安县丞、江浙儒学副提举，因方国珍事与朝廷议不合而弃官归隐；至正二十年（1360）朱元璋以金币遣使聘至应天，陈时务十八策，建礼贤馆礼遇之，'每召入，辄屏人密语移时'；力主'先陈后张'次第剪除方略，佐定龙湾、鄱阳之役，洪武初为御史中丞兼太史令，参与议定《大明律》、考定《大统历》；性刚嫉恶，与李善长、胡惟庸相忤，洪武四年（1371）以妻丧告老归隐青田，'惟饮酒弈棋，口不言功'；洪武八年（1375）忧愤而卒（传为胡惟庸挟医来视而鸩之），正德中谥文成；元末著《郁离子》二百余则寓言，身后《烧饼歌》托名流传，与宋濂、叶琛、章溢并称'浙东四先生'
civilization_en: The world of Zhedong strategists at the Yuan-Ming transition: born in Wuyang village, Qingtian, Chuzhou (1311), courtesy name Bowen; jinshi of 1333 under the Yuan, serving as assistant magistrate in Gao'an and vice-intendant of schools in Jiangzhe, until disagreement over the Fang Guozhen affair drove him into retirement; in 1360 Zhu Yuanzhang sent envoys with gold and silk to summon him to Yingtian, where he presented the Eighteen Policies on the Times, was lodged in the Hall for Honoring the Worthy, and conferred nightly behind closed doors; he championed the sequence 'Chen first, Zhang second' and directed the battles of Longwan and Lake Poyang; in early Hongwu he served as censor-in-chief and director of astronomy, helping draft the Great Ming Code and fix the Great Concord calendar; stern by nature and hating evil, at odds with Li Shanchang and Hu Weiyong, he retired to Qingtian in 1371 upon his wife's death, 'drinking wine and playing go, never speaking of merit'; he died in 1375 in grief (by tradition poisoned by a physician sent by Hu Weiyong), posthumously enfeoffed as Earl Wencheng; in late Yuan he wrote the Yulizi's two hundred allegories, and the Baked-Cake Song circulated after his death under his name, one of the 'Four Worthies of Zhedong' with Song Lian, Ye Chen and Zhang Yi

cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯温与张载共享'为天下立法'的经世抱负而路径不同：张载以《横渠四句》立'为天地立心'的哲学纲领、以井田理想试于乡治——学者在民间立法；刘伯温以时务十八策进入权力核心、以《大明律》成文化天下——谋士在庙堂立法。两人同出'关洛—浙东'的经世谱系，一个示范了理念立法的高度，一个示范了成文立法的工程。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bowen and Zhang Zai share the statecraft ambition of 'legislating for the world' by different routes: Zhang set the philosophical charter of 'fixing the heart for heaven and earth' and tested the well-field ideal in rural governance — a scholar legislating among the people; Liu entered the seat of power with the Eighteen Policies and codified the realm in the Great Ming Code — a strategist legislating at court. Both descend from the statecraft lineage of Guan-Luo and Zhedong; one shows the height of legislating in ideas, the other the engineering of legislating in statutes.

cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯温与黄宗羲同为浙东学人、同面对'学者与皇权如何相处'的命题而给出镜像答案：刘伯温入局佐命、立法垂典，终以功成身退保全于猜忌之世；黄宗羲拒仕新朝、以《明夷待访录》为君主制度立批判之典。一个在体制内立法，一个在体制外立法——《明夷待访录·原法》'有治法而后有治人'，正是对刘伯温参与制定的那部《大明律》未竟之业的隔代接续。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bowen and Huang Zongxi, both sons of Zhedong learning, faced the same question — how a scholar stands to imperial power — and gave mirror answers: Liu entered the founding, codified institutions, and preserved himself by timely withdrawal in an age of suspicion; Huang refused the new dynasty and codified a critique of monarchy in Waiting for the Dawn. One legislated within the system, one outside — and the Waiting for the Dawn's 'first there must be good laws, then there can be good men' is precisely a later-generation continuation of the unfinished work of the Great Ming Code Liu helped draft.

cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯温与董仲舒同为'帝师型'学者而术数立场相反：董仲舒以灾异谴告建构天人感应、把天象立为制约君权的实体——占候是政治神学；刘伯温一生精于象纬而断言'占之者心也，非卦也'——占候被还原为时机工程与人心判断。同样面对'天象与政治'的接口，一个把接口本体化，一个把接口工具化，两条路线共同构成中国术数政治学的两极。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bowen and Dong Zhongshu, both 'teacher to the emperor' scholars, took opposite stands on the mantic arts: Dong built the heaven-human resonance on disaster admonitions, making the sky a substantive check on the ruler — divination as political theology; Liu, a lifetime master of the asterisms, concluded 'what divines is the mind, not the hexagram' — divination reduced to timing engineering and human judgment. Facing the same interface of sky and politics, one ontologized it, the other instrumentalized it; together they mark the two poles of Chinese astro-politics.

cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯温与金圣叹同为浙江文人、同以'体制外文体'存思想而命运两极：刘伯温以寓言（《郁离子》）藏批判于虚构、以仕进与身退完成思想的完整生命周期；金圣叹以评点立'才子书'、以狂士之身死于哭庙。两人都证明'文体即生存策略'——寓言让刘伯温穿越元末言祸，评点让金圣叹穿越明清易代的文字狱前夜；一个用文体换来了进退自如，一个用文体守住了最后的心声。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bowen and Jin Shengtan, both literati of Zhejiang, stored thought in 'extra-systemic genres' with opposite fates: Liu hid critique in allegory (the Yulizi) and completed his thought's full life-cycle through service and withdrawal; Jin founded the 'talented-writer books' in commentary and died the wild scholar at the Weeping Temple. Both prove 'genre is survival strategy' — allegory carried Liu through the speech-perils of late Yuan, commentary carried Jin to the eve of the Qing's literary inquisitions; one traded genre for freedom of advance and retreat, the other kept genre as his last utterance.

modes.domain_zh: 多敌并存时不按仇恨或难易排序，而按'先取谁则全局最优'排序：先弱后强、先近后远、先断其臂后攻其心——把一场不可能同时打赢的战争，改写成一组一次只打一场的战争
modes.domain_en: When many enemies coexist, order them not by grievance or ease but by 'whose removal first optimizes the whole': weak before strong, near before far, sever the arm before striking the heart — rewriting an unwinnable simultaneous war into a sequence of winnable single wars
modes.source_chapter: 至正二十年（1360）应朱元璋聘，陈'时务十八策'；定先征陈友谅、后灭张士诚之方略
modes.key_quote_zh: 士诚自守虏，不足虑；友谅劫主胁下，名号不正，地据上流，其心无日忘我，宜先图之。陈氏灭，张氏益孤，一举可定
modes.key_quote_en: 'Shi Cheng is a self-guarding captive, no cause for worry; Youliang holds the sovereign hostage, his mandate crooked, his base upstream, his heart set daily on us — take him first. Once Chen falls, Zhang is isolated, and one stroke settles him.'
process_zh: 列出全部对手并放弃'同时解决'的幻想：承认多线作战是资源定律下的必败结构，把问题从'打谁'改写为'先打谁'
按'削弱后的连锁反应'而非'当下的强弱'排序：评估消灭每个对手后全局力量对比如何变化，选连锁增益最大者为第一目标
以'势'设计隔离：在攻打第一目标时，用外交、封赏、地理屏障冻结其余对手，确保每一阶段都是单线作战
每胜一局即重新全局排序：胜者的位置会改变次序本身——上一轮的排序不自动延续，每阶段重算
process_en: Enumerate all opponents and abandon the fantasy of solving them simultaneously: concede that multi-front war is a structurally losing arrangement, and rewrite the question from 'whom to fight' to 'whom to fight first'
Rank by the chain reaction after weakening, not by present strength: assess how the balance shifts once each opponent falls, and pick as first target the one with the largest chain gain
Design isolation through shi (positional momentum): while attacking target one, freeze the rest with diplomacy, rewards and geography, so every phase is a single-front war
Re-rank the whole board after each victory: the winner's new position changes the ordering itself — never let the previous round's sequence carry over automatically
representative_cases_zh: 1360 年陈时务十八策，力主'先陈后张'：诸将多主张先取富庶的苏杭（张士诚），刘基独断张是'自守虏'、陈友谅才是心腹之患——顶住直觉（先打富的）按连锁反应排序
龙湾之战（1360）诱陈友谅深入然后聚歼：不打第一枪，而把对手诱到'我方最优序'的位置上再动手
鄱阳湖决战（1363）时预言'金星在上流'请朱元璋移舟当火起处：决战时刻的排序仍精确到时辰与座船
representative_cases_en: In 1360 the Eighteen Policies on the Times argued 'Chen first, Zhang second': most generals wanted rich Suzhou-Hangzhou (Zhang) first, but Liu alone judged Zhang 'a self-guarding captive' and Chen the mortal threat — overriding intuition (hit the rich one) in favor of chain-reaction ordering
The Battle of Longwan (1360): luring Chen Youliang deep before annihilating him — never firing the first shot, but maneuvering the opponent onto the position where 'our optimal sequence' applies
At Lake Poyang (1363) he read the Venus position and had Zhu move his flagship to where the fire would start: at the decisive moment the sequencing held down to the hour and the flagship
modern_applications_zh: 竞争战略的'战场选择'：不与所有对手同时开战，按'打倒谁能让其余对手变弱'排定进入次序
技术债务与产品路线图：按'解决后能让其余问题变简单'排序，而非按表面难易或呼声高低
个人精力管理：承认无法并行打赢所有战线，每季度只保留一条主战线并主动冻结其余
modern_applications_en: Battlefield selection in competitive strategy: never fight all rivals at once; order entries by 'whose fall weakens the rest'
Tech debt and roadmapping: rank by 'which fix simplifies the others', not by surface difficulty or loudest complaint
Personal energy management: concede you cannot win every front in parallel; keep one main front per quarter and deliberately freeze the rest
representative_figures: 刘伯温（核心）
朱元璋（执行：把时序方略变成国策的主君）
曹操（对照：官渡之战先破袁绍、远征乌桓的次第选择）
诸葛亮（对照：隆中对的跨 polarity 时序蓝图，而未及次第收官）

modes.domain_zh: 胜负在交手前先在'形势'上判定：先审天下大势与各方力量几何级数的消长，再谈战术——不指望用战斗的胜利弥补战略的破产，而是让战斗成为战略早已写好的结论
modes.domain_en: Victory is decided before engagement in the 'configuration': first read the grand trend and the exponential ebb and flow of powers, then talk tactics — never expect a battle to rescue a bankrupt strategy, but let battle merely certify what strategy has already written
modes.source_chapter: 时务十八策总纲；佐朱元璋'缓称王、广积粮'的形势经营
modes.key_quote_zh: 今天下非汉唐比，宜决策于形势，不可侥幸于一胜
modes.key_quote_en: 'The empire today is not what Han or Tang faced: decide by configuration, do not gamble on a single victory.'
process_zh: 先画'势图'再谈'战图'：把天下各方的人口、粮饷、地理、道义名分摆上同一张桌面，看清谁在自然增长、谁在自然衰减
把自己放进消长的曲线里选位：不追求当下最强，而追求站在'正在增长'的那条曲线上——时间站在谁那边比谁更强更决定结局
用战术去'兑现'形势而不去'创造'形势：每一仗都选在形势已向己方倾斜的位置打，打赢是验证而非翻盘
警惕'侥幸胜'：一场靠运气赢下的战役若违背形势判断，当视为警报而非捷报
process_en: Draw the map of shi before the map of battle: put every power's population, grain, geography and moral mandate on one table, and see who is growing and who is decaying
Position yourself inside the curve of change: seek not present strength but a seat on the rising curve — whose side time is on decides more than who is stronger
Use tactics to cash in the configuration, not to conjure it: fight only where the configuration already tilts your way, so victory is verification, not reversal
Distrust 'lucky wins': a battle won by chance against the configuration read is an alarm, not a triumph
representative_cases_zh: 力赞'高筑墙、广积粮、缓称王'：在群雄争相僭号的形势下，独赞'缓称王'这条不让名声成为靶子的曲线——用名分上的落后换取增长的安全
断言陈友谅'地据上流而名号不正'：把道义名分计入形势计算，预判其内部人心不聚、一战可溃
每战之前先议'胜了之后天下如何'：把战役当作形势曲线上的取值点，而非独立事件
representative_cases_en: He championed 'build high walls, store wide grain, delay the crown': amid rivals racing to usurp royal titles, he alone backed the curve that refused to make one's name a target — trading heraldic lag for growth's safety
He judged Chen Youliang 'upstream in position but crooked in mandate': moral legitimacy entered the configuration calculus, predicting Chen's scattered morale and one-battle collapse
Before every campaign he first asked 'what does the empire look like after we win': each battle taken as a sample point on the curve of configuration, never a standalone event
modern_applications_zh: 创业赛道的'势'选择：选正在增长的市场而非当下最大的市场——时间站在谁那边
组织决策的'先胜后战'：重要谈判先在条款与联盟上建立压倒性形势，再进会议室
个人职业判断：评估行业曲线而非岗位薪资，站在上升曲线上接受阶段性弱势
modern_applications_en: Choosing the track by shi in startups: pick the growing market, not the biggest today — ask whose side time is on
Pre-victory in organizational deals: build an overwhelming configuration of terms and alliances before entering the room
Career judgment: appraise the industry curve over the payroll line; accept positional weakness on a rising curve
representative_figures: 刘伯温（核心）
朱元璋（执行：以'缓称王'把形势经营变成国策）
孙子（上游：'胜兵先胜而后求战'的兵学源头）
张良（对照：同为帝王师，以'势'助汉定天下）

modes.domain_zh: 把天文观测转译为行动时机：观天象不为预知命运，而为选择'条件最优的那一时辰'——占候之学的现代内核是时机工程：在信息不完全时，用一切可读信号为不可逆行动定位时间窗
modes.domain_en: Translating astronomical observation into action timing: reading the heavens not to know fate but to select 'the hour when conditions are optimal' — the modern core of astral arts is timing engineering: under incomplete information, use every readable signal to locate the window for an irreversible act
modes.source_chapter: 《清类天文分野书》之学与佐命历法；龙湾、鄱阳诸役'观天象而定进退'的运用
modes.key_quote_zh: 基博通经史，于书无不窥，尤精象纬之学
modes.key_quote_en: 'Liu scoured every book of history and canon; in the lore of the asterisms and their shadows he was supreme.'
process_zh: 承认时机不可逆：渡江、决战、称王这类行动没有'先试一试'，误差的代价是全部——因此值得为'选对时辰'单独立学
把模糊信号变成可比较的刻度：天象、气候、士气、敌情都被读成'宜/不宜'的刻度，让不同来源的信息可以在同一决策里加权
等待窗口而非制造窗口：多数时候按兵不动，把功夫花在'窗口出现时已在正确位置上'——龙湾之战是先布好口袋再候陈友谅入彀
窗口关闭前决断：信号一旦给出'宜'，立即行动不迁延——时机的价值在于排他性，错过即归零
process_en: Concede that timing is irreversible: river-crossings, decisive battles, claimings of the crown allow no trial run — the cost of error is everything, so 'choosing the hour' deserves its own discipline
Turn fuzzy signals into comparable scales: asterisms, weather, morale, enemy intelligence are all read as 'go / no-go' marks, so heterogeneous information can be weighted in one decision
Wait for the window rather than force it: mostly hold still, spending effort on 'being in position when the window opens' — Longwan was a net set first, Chen's entry awaited second
Decide before the window closes: once the signal reads 'go', act at once — the value of timing lies in exclusivity; missed, it resets to zero
representative_cases_zh: 鄱阳湖之战中观'金星犯上将'请朱元璋移舟：次日座船果然被炮石击碎——把星象当作风险预警系统使用而非仪式
佐定历法、考定《大统历》：把占候之学沉淀为国家历法制度——观天从权术变成基础设施
劝太祖'俟其骄'：对骄兵之敌的时机判断——等对手的自我评价脱离现实再出手
representative_cases_en: At Lake Poyang, reading 'Venus transgressing the General' he had Zhu shift his vessel: next day the flagship was smashed by stone-shot — the stars used as a risk-warning system, not a rite
He helped fix the Great Concord calendar: distilling astral arts into state calendrical infrastructure — sky-reading turned from a trick into public works
He advised 'let him ripen in arrogance': timing against an overconfident foe — strike only after the enemy's self-image has left reality
modern_applications_zh: 重大发布的'时机工程'：把市场情绪、竞品动作、内部就绪度都读成'宜/不宜'刻度，为不可逆发布选窗
金融交易的时间窗管理：信号齐备立即执行——时机的价值在于排他性
个人重大决策（换城市、离职）：承认不可逆，建立自己的多信号'宜/不宜'清单，窗口出现即行动
modern_applications_en: Timing engineering for major launches: read market mood, competitor moves and internal readiness as go/no-go marks, and pick the window for an irreversible release
Window management in trading: when signals align, execute at once — timing's value lies in its exclusivity
Big personal decisions (relocation, resignation): concede irreversibility, build your own multi-signal go/no-go list, act when the window opens
representative_figures: 刘伯温（核心）
张良（上游：'运筹帷幄之中'兼通太乙的谋士原型）
郭守敬（对照：同精天文，一个用于历法公共化、一个用于军事时机）
诸葛亮（对照：观星象而'知天命不可强'的先例）
modes.definition_zh: 把天文观测转译为行动时机：观天象不为预知命运，而为选择'条件最优的那一时辰'——占候之学的现代内核是时机工程：在信息不完全时，用一切可读信号为不可逆行动定位时间窗
modes.definition_en: Translating astronomical observation into action timing: reading the heavens not to know fate but to select 'the hour when conditions are optimal' — the modern core of astral arts is timing engineering: under incomplete information, use every readable signal to locate the window for an irreversible act

modes.domain_zh: 在言祸遍布的环境里，把政治批判装进寓言的容器：借郁离子的对话说君臣、借楚人养猴说赋敛、借赵人患鼠说用人——真话穿上故事的外衣，批判获得'虚构的豁免权'，得以穿越审查抵达后世
modes.domain_en: In an environment thick with peril for speech, pack political critique into the vessel of allegory: through Yu the Illustrious one debates rulers and ministers, through the Chu man and his monkeys one exposes taxation, through the Zhao man's rats one argues personnel — truth dressed in story gains 'the immunity of fiction' and crosses censorship to reach posterity
modes.source_chapter: 《郁离子》二百余则寓言（元末弃官后著）；《卖柑者言》
modes.key_quote_zh: 郁离子曰：其为言也，杂于世俗之间，而见谓不肖，故不为人所用
modes.key_quote_en: 'Yu the Illustrious said: my words, mixed into the common world, are taken for folly — and so no one employs me.'
process_zh: 先给批判定价：判断这条真话直说会付出什么代价（杀身、流放、禁毁），价格高于承受力就换容器——寓言是给真话买的保险
把论点翻译成'人物—处境—后果'三件套：不写'赋敛过重',而写狙公赋茅'朝三而暮四'——抽象命题落进具体命运，读者自己得出结论
保留可追溯的签名：寓言的角色与意象自成体系（郁离子=智者之音），让知音者能回溯到作者的真意——曲笔不等于匿名
批判力与生存力同时设计：一则寓言要经得起当权者的'看不懂'，也要经得起后世读者的'看得懂'——双重时间的写作
process_en: Price the critique first: what would this truth cost if said straight — death, exile, the burning of books? If the price exceeds your capacity, change the vessel; allegory is insurance bought for truth

Translate the argument into 'character — predicament — consequence': never write 'taxation is crushing', write the monkey-keeper's 'three at morning, four at dusk' — abstract propositions fall into concrete fates, and readers draw their own conclusions

Keep a traceable signature: the allegories form a system (Yu the Illustrious = the voice of the wise), letting kindred readers trace back to the author's real meaning — a crooked brush is not an anonymous one
Design for critical force and survival at once: an allegory must survive the ruler's 'not understanding' and the later reader's 'understanding' — writing for a double time
representative_cases_zh: 《郁离子》成书于仕元绝望、佐明未起之际：把'天下何以乱'的全部判断写进寓言，成为后来时务十八策的思想底稿——寓言是战略的草稿纸
《卖柑者言》借卖柑小贩之口'金玉其外、败絮其中'：以虚构对话完成对官僚体系的总批判，作者只作记录者
寓言《楚人养狙》以'朝三暮四'写赋税盘剥的破产：狙公最终被众狙所溃——权力经济学的完整模型藏在故事里
representative_cases_en: The Yulizi was written in his despair over Yuan service, before Zhu's summons: his whole verdict on 'why the empire falls' lives in allegories that became the draft of the later Eighteen Policies — allegory as strategic scratch paper

The Orange Seller's Words puts 'gold and jade outside, rotten cotton within' in a street peddler's mouth: a total indictment of the bureaucracy delivered as fiction, the author posing as mere recorder
The allegory of the Chu monkey-keeper renders fiscal extortion as 'three at morning, four at dusk': the keeper finally overrun by his monkeys — a complete model of power economics hidden in a tale
modern_applications_zh: 高压组织的'案例化表达'：用虚构案例与第三方故事传达不可直说的组织批评——故事获得豁免权
科技伦理写作：以思想实验（电车、猴子、机器）承载对技术的批判——寓言是伦理学的度量衡
内容创作的'双重时间'设计：作品既过得了当下审查，又经得起十年后重读——寓言体的信息压缩比最高
modern_applications_en: Case-based speech in high-pressure organizations: voice unspeakable institutional critique through fictional cases and third-party stories — story earns the immunity
Tech-ethics writing: carrying critiques of technology by thought experiment (trolleys, monkeys, machines) — allegory as ethics's measuring instrument
'Double-time' design in content: work that passes today's censor and rewards a rereading in ten years — allegory has the highest compression ratio
representative_figures: 刘伯温（核心）
庄子（上游：寓言十九的言说传统源头）
柳宗元（对照：三戒以动物寓言论政）
伊索（平行：异文明同构的寓言豁免策略）

modes.domain_zh: 以法典替代君主的临时处置：参与起草《大明律》，把'赏罚由一时喜怒'改写为'赏罚由可预期的成文法'——治术的最高形式不是更聪明的决断，而是让决断本身被规则约束
modes.domain_en: Replace the ruler's ad hoc disposal with a code: helping draft the Great Ming Code, rewriting 'reward and punishment by momentary mood' into 'reward and punishment by predictable statute' — the highest form of statecraft is not a cleverer decision but a decision itself bound by rules
modes.source_chapter: 洪武年间与李善长等议定《大明律》；《明史·刑法志》所载定律讨论
modes.key_quote_zh: 宋元以来，宽纵日久，当以猛济宽；然立法贵在简要，使人易晓而难犯
modes.key_quote_en: 'Since Song and Yuan, indulgence has run long; severity must mend laxity. Yet a code must be brief and clear — easy to know, hard to breach.'
process_zh: 先诊断'人治失灵的机制'再立法：宋亡于宽纵、元亡于失序——法典要治的不是具体罪名，而是让王朝崩溃的那种'不可预期性'
律文从简、罚则从严：'使人易晓而难犯'——可预期性优先于完备性，一部人人读得懂的严法胜过一部无人读得懂的密网
把君权纳入律文的边界内：定律时反复讨论'恩旨能否破律'——用成文法约束的不只是臣民，还有皇帝自己的随意性
立法与教化并行：法典划底线，学校与旌表立高线——刑法只做社会成本最低的那一段治理
process_en: Diagnose the mechanism of rule-of-man failure before codifying: Song fell to indulgence, Yuan to disorder — the code must cure not particular crimes but the very 'unpredictability' that topples dynasties
Simple statutes, strict penalties: 'easy to know, hard to breach' — predictability over completeness; one severe law all can read beats a dense net none can

Bring sovereign power inside the code's boundary: in drafting, the recurrent question was whether imperial grace could break the statute — the code binds not only subjects but the emperor's own arbitrariness
Legislate alongside moral education: the code draws the floor, schools and commendations raise the ceiling — penal law governs only the segment with the lowest social cost
representative_cases_zh: 议定律令时主张'简要'：明初法网一度繁密，刘基力主删并——从数千条到'轻重适宜'，可预期性成为立法的第一指标
以'宽猛相济'定基调：既纠正元末宽纵，又防止以猛治国滑向滥杀——立法是两种失灵之间的窄门
律成之后力谏'慎刑'：对具体案件坚持'律外无刑'——法典的威信靠每一件个案的执行来支付
representative_cases_en: In codifying he pressed for brevity: the early Ming net grew dense, and Liu urged consolidation — from thousands of articles to 'severity in due measure', predictability became the code's first metric

He set the keynote of 'leniency and severity tempering each other': correcting late-Yuan laxity while barring the slide from severity into massacre — legislation as the narrow gate between two modes of failure
After the code was fixed he petitioned for 'judicial caution': in concrete cases he insisted 'no penalty outside the code' — a statute's authority is paid for case by case
modern_applications_zh: 组织章程的'可预期性优先'：制度宁简勿密——人人读得懂的严规则胜过无人读得懂的密规则
平台治理的成文化：把'随项目心情'的奖惩改写为公开可预期的规则，约束的不只是用户还有平台自身
个人自律的'立法思维'：给自己立简要而严格执行的少数规则，而非无限扩张的自训清单
modern_applications_en: Predictability first in organizational charters: prefer simple over dense — a strict rule everyone can read beats a dense net no one can
Codification in platform governance: rewrite mood-driven rewards and penalties into public, predictable rules that bind the platform as much as its users
A legislator's mind for personal discipline: enact a few simple, strictly kept rules rather than an ever-expanding self-training list

李善长（同僚：总裁定律的行政主持人）
商鞅（对照：同为变法立法者，一个立'法贵简要'、一个立'轻罪重罚'）
黄宗羲（传承：其'有治法而后有治人'承明初立法讨论而来）

modes.domain_zh: 占卜的真正机关不在卦象而在人心：'先天而天弗违'——术数之学的正确用法是'先定其心，再观其变'，把占卜从'预测未来'改造为'检验自己判断的工具'，最终以《郁离子》断言'天之下民，其生也神'而归于人本
modes.domain_en: The true mechanism of divination lies not in the hexagram but in the mind: 'act from the innate, and heaven does not contradict' — the right use of mantic arts is 'settle the mind first, then read the change', converting divination from predicting the future into an instrument for testing one's own judgment, until the Yulizi asserts 'the people under heaven are born divine' and lands on humanism
modes.source_chapter: 《郁离子》'天道'诸篇；《春秋明经》对灾异说的经学重释
modes.key_quote_zh: 天人一理也，占之者心也，非卦也
modes.key_quote_en: 'Heaven and man share one pattern; what divines is the mind, not the hexagram.'
process_zh: 先分'术'与'道'：卦象、星象是术，其背后的天人感应之理是道——学占先学理，理明则术可弃可存
把占卜降格为'判断检验器'：起卦之前先写下自己的判断，卦象只用来对照而非替代——占得的'吉凶'本质上是与自己判断的一次辩论
以人心为最终变量：同一卦象在不同人心与不同处境下含义不同——变量是人，不是卦；'先天而天弗违'意味着判断的主体性优先于符号系统
归于人本：术数学到尽头，结论是'民之所欲，天必从之'——把神圣性从天象移回人间民生，占候之学的终点是民本政治学
process_en: Split the 'technique' from the 'way': hexagrams and asterisms are technique; the resonance of heaven and man behind them is the way — learn the principle first, and once it is clear the technique may be kept or dropped

Demote divination to a judgment-testing device: write down your own judgment before casting; the hexagram is for comparison, not replacement — its 'fortune' is in essence a debate with your own judgment

Make the human mind the final variable: the same hexagram means differently under different minds and situations — the variable is the person, not the sign; 'act from the innate and heaven does not contradict' means the primacy of the judging subject over the symbol system

Land on humanism: pursued to its end, the mantic arts yield 'what the people desire, heaven follows' — moving the sacred from the sky back to livelihood, astral learning terminating in a politics of the people
representative_cases_zh: 《郁离子》'东陵侯问卜'一则：司马季主答'激湍之下，必有深潭'而归'吉凶由人'——用占者的口吻瓦解占卜的决定论
解《春秋》灾异而不泥于灾异：日食、星变被读成'天之警君'的修辞而非机械因果——经学解读与占候技术的分野
佐命之后自焚象纬秘籍：术成而不传其术——对占候之学的最终态度是'可用于一时，不可恃于一世'
representative_cases_en: In the Yulizi's 'The Marquis of Dongling asks about divination', Ssu-ma Chi-chu answers 'beneath the rushing torrent there must be a deep pool' and lands on 'fortune is made by man' — using the diviner's own voice to dissolve divination's determinism

He read the Spring and Autumn's portents without being bound by them: eclipses and anomalies became 'heaven admonishing the ruler' as rhetoric, not mechanical causation — the watershed between classical reading and mantic technique
After the dynasty was won, he burned the secret books of astral arts: mastery refusing transmission — the final attitude that such arts 'serve an hour but cannot be relied on for an age'
modern_applications_zh: 决策工具的正确姿态：任何模型（算法、评分、AI 预测）都应'先写己见，再对模型'——工具是判断的辩论对手而非替代者
组织里的'数据迷信'矫正：指标是'卦'，决策者的人心与处境才是变量——先定决策逻辑，再看数据是否反驳
个人对'测试与占卜'的用法：塔罗、测评、性格测试当作自省的镜子而非命运的判决——'占之者心也，非卦也'
modern_applications_en: The right posture toward decision tools: for any model (algorithm, score, AI forecast), write your own view first, then confront the model — the tool is a debating opponent for judgment, not its replacement
Correcting data superstition in organizations: metrics are the hexagram; the decision-maker's mind and situation are the variables — fix the decision logic first, then see if data refutes it
Using tests and divination personally: tarot, assessments, personality tests as mirrors for reflection, not verdicts of fate — 'what divines is the mind, not the hexagram'

modes.domain_zh: 把'退出'当作事业的最后一项设计而非失败：天下已定即辞爵归田，不结党、不恋权、不留柄——退出本身是一门工程，需要在权力还容忍你的时候就开始为'不再被需要'做准备
modes.domain_en: Treat 'exit' as the final design of a career, not its failure: once the realm is settled, resign titles and return to the fields — no faction, no clinging to power, no hostages left behind. Exit is itself an engineering problem: begin preparing for 'no longer needed' while power still tolerates you
modes.source_chapter: 洪武四年（1371）告老归田；拒绝再起与晚年'饮鸩'传说所映照的退隐困境
modes.key_quote_zh: 基佐定天下，料事如神……然性刚嫉恶，与物多忤。至是还隐山中，惟饮酒弈棋，口不言功
modes.key_quote_en: 'Liu helped settle the empire, divining events like a god... yet by nature stern and hating evil, he crossed many. Then he withdrew to the mountains, drinking wine and playing go, his mouth never speaking of merit.'
process_zh: 预设事业的终点条款：入局之前就想好'局终我何在'——把退出条件（天下已定、功高震主、鸟尽弓藏）写进自己的事业计划
以'不可恃'为常态设计资产结构：爵位、权力、声望都是君主可以单方收回的资产，真正可恃的是淡出后仍存在的家庭、著作与门生
选择'被需要'峰值之后的下坡起点退出：退出不是在失宠时仓皇逃离，而是在尚有议价能力时主动让位——递出辞呈的时机本身就是最后一份谋略
退出后执行'口不言功'纪律：不消费旧功、不议论朝政、不接旧部之请——把退出做彻底，才保得住退出
process_en: Draft the career's terminal clause before entering: know 'where will I stand when the game ends' — write exit conditions (realm settled, merit overshadowing the lord, the bow shelved once birds are gone) into one's own plan

Structure assets on the premise that nothing royal is safe: title, office, fame are all assets the sovereign can reclaim unilaterally; what truly endures after fading out is family, writings, students

Exit at the start of the downslope past peak 'needed-ness': not a panicked flight at disgrace, but stepping aside while bargaining power remains — the timing of the resignation letter is itself the last stratagem

After exit, enforce the discipline of 'never speaking of merit': no spending old credit, no commenting on court affairs, no granting old subordinates' requests — only a thorough exit preserves the exit
representative_cases_zh: 洪武四年以妻丧为契机告老：在功业顶点与猜忌升温的交点选择下坡——比李善长、胡惟庸早离开权力场十余年
归隐后'惟饮酒弈棋，口不言功'，县令求见皆避：彻底切断'退休谋士'的政治接口——隐居不是姿态而是断联
临终前以《天文书》授子琏嘱其呈御：把最敏感的知识产权主动上缴——退出工程里连身后著述的去向都预作安排
representative_cases_en: In the fourth Hongwu year he retired citing his wife's death, at the crossing of career zenith and rising suspicion — leaving the power arena a decade before Li Shanchang and Hu Weiyong fell

In retirement 'he drank wine and played go, his mouth never speaking of merit', dodging even the county magistrate's visits: a total cut of the 'retired strategist' political interface — seclusion as disconnection, not posture

On his deathbed he had his son Liu Lian present the Book of Celestial Patterns to the throne: surrendering his most sensitive intellectual property in advance — exit engineering arranged even for posthumous writings
modern_applications_zh: 创始人的退出工程：在公司'还需要你'的峰值后规划交接——退出时点本身就是最后一份战略
职场高管的'功成身退'：不恋战、不结派、主动让位换取体面与安全——递辞呈的时机是最后一份谈判筹码
个人声誉管理：退出后'口不言功'——不消费旧功劳、不议论老东家，把退出做彻底才保得住退出
modern_applications_en: Founder exit engineering: plan succession just past the peak of 'still needed' — the exit point is itself a final strategy
Executive withdrawal: no clinging, no factions, stepping aside for dignity and safety — the timing of the resignation letter is the last bargaining chip
Reputation management after exit: 'never speak of merit' — no spending old credit, no talking about the old employer; only a thorough exit preserves the exit
representative_figures: 刘伯温（核心）
范蠡（上游：泛舟五湖的功成身退原型）
张良（上游：'愿弃人间事'从赤松子游的同类选择）
李善长（对照：不知退出而族灭的反例）
modes.definition_zh: 把'退出'当作事业的最后一项设计而非失败：天下已定即辞爵归田，不结党、不恋权、不留柄——退出本身是一门工程，需要在权力还容忍你的时候就开始为'不再被需要'做准备
modes.definition_en: Treat 'exit' as the final design of a career, not its failure: once the realm is settled, resign titles and return to the fields — no faction, no clinging to power, no hostages left behind. Exit is itself an engineering problem: begin preparing for 'no longer needed' while power still tolerates you

modes.name_en: The Method of the Counsel's Forum
modes.domain_zh: 谋士价值的实现依赖一个'可对问'的结构：不是零散进言，而是与主君建立固定的对谈机制（礼聘、密室、问而后对）——把个人才智嵌入'提问权与回答权都受保护的对话结构'，谋略才能穿越猜忌被采纳
modes.domain_en: A counselor's value depends on a structure 'where questioning is possible': not scattered petitions but a fixed dialogue mechanism with the lord (formal invitation, private chamber, answers only when asked) — embedding individual intellect in a dialogue structure where both the right to ask and to answer are protected, so strategy can cross suspicion and be adopted
modes.source_chapter: 至正二十年（1360）朱元璋以金币遣使聘于处州；建礼贤馆；'每召入，辄屏人语移时'
modes.key_quote_zh: 太祖筑礼贤馆处基等，每召入，辄屏人密语移时
modes.key_quote_en: 'The Taizu built the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to lodge Liu and his peers; whenever he summoned him in, he would clear the room and confer in secret for hours.'
process_zh: 先审'聘礼'再出山：出仕前考察对方是否愿意支付'礼'的成本——礼贤馆、专使、尊号都是对方承诺'对问结构'的抵押品
争取'屏人密语'的场域：谋略的价值密度越高，越需要排除旁听者的对话结构——公开场合只说公开能说的话
坚持'问而后对'的节律：不抢答、不越权、只在被问到时给出完整方案——回答权的边界是对问结构能持续的前提
把对谈成果转化为制度而非私恩：十八策进于前而定'先陈后张'为方略——谋略被采纳的标志是变成国策，而非换来宠信
process_en: Inspect the 'terms of invitation' before coming out: examine whether the other side will pay the cost of 'li' (ritual honor) — the hall for the worthy, the special envoy, the honored title are all collateral for a promised dialogue structure
Secure the chamber with the room cleared: the denser a strategy's value, the more it needs dialogue stripped of eavesdroppers — in public, speak only what can be public
Keep the rhythm of 'answer only when asked': no volunteering, no overstepping, a full plan given only upon inquiry — the boundary of the right to answer is the premise of the dialogue's survival

Convert dialogue outcomes into institutions, not private favor: the Eighteen Policies became the strategy 'Chen first, Zhang second' — a strategy is adopted when it becomes state policy, not when it buys favor
representative_cases_zh: 孙炎再使处州、以剑赠基：朱元璋两次遣使、一次赠剑，支付的'礼'的成本换来了对问结构的成立
礼贤馆中与宋濂、章溢、叶琛并置：谋士不是一个人而是一个被供养的机构——对问结构需要组织化的承载
'屏人语移时'的制度化：重要决策都以密谈先行、朝议在后——对话结构反过来塑造了决策流程
representative_cases_en: Sun Yan's second mission to Chuzhou, presenting a sword: two envoys and one blade paid the cost of 'li' that established the dialogue structure
The Hall for Honoring the Worthy lodging Song Lian, Zhang Yi and Ye Chen beside Liu: counselors are not one man but an endowed institution — the dialogue structure needs organizational housing
The institutionalized 'room cleared, hours conferred': major decisions ran secret counsel first, court debate after — the dialogue structure reshaped the decision process in return
modern_applications_zh: 高管顾问的'对问机制'设计：与决策者约定固定的一对一密谈节律——谋略要落地先要有受保护的对话场
组织设立'礼贤'机制：智囊团、外部董事、red team 的价值取决于是否有'屏人密语'的制度承载
咨询项目的'问而后对'纪律：只在被问到时给完整方案，不抢答不越权——回答权边界决定顾问关系寿命
modern_applications_en: Designing a counsel's forum for executive advisors: a fixed rhythm of one-on-one private meetings — strategy lands only where dialogue is protected
Building 'hall for the worthy' mechanisms in organizations: think tanks, outside directors, red teams — their worth depends on institutional space for 'the room cleared'
The 'answer when asked' discipline in consulting: full plans only upon inquiry, no volunteering, no overstepping — the boundary of the right to answer sets the relationship's lifespan
representative_figures: 刘伯温（核心）
张良（上游：帝王师'运筹帷幄'的原型）
诸葛亮（对照：隆中对的自荐式对问）
管仲（对照：以相位换取长期对问结构的先例）

modes.name_en: The Method of Learning for Use
modes.domain_zh: 把全部学问统摄于'经世致用'一个标准之下：经史、天文、兵法、术数、诗文不为博学而博学，各自都要回答'能用来解决什么现实问题'——知识的合法性来自其用，博学是致用的副产品而非目标
modes.domain_en: Subsume all learning under one criterion — service to the world: classics, history, astronomy, strategy, mantic arts, poetry — none pursued for erudition's sake; each must answer 'what live problem does it solve'. Knowledge's legitimacy lies in its use; erudition is a by-product of usefulness, not the goal
modes.source_chapter: 《诚意伯文集》自序诸论；《春秋明经》以经义断时政
modes.key_quote_zh: 学足以探其奥，则用无不该；不通乎用，则虽博何益
modes.key_quote_en: 'When learning fathoms the inner springs, no use escapes it; if it cannot reach use, what good is all its breadth?'
process_zh: 给每个知识领域登记'用途'：学天文记其可用于历法与时机，学兵法记其可用于方略，学经义记其可断时政——无用途登记的学问不入主修
以问题为纲重组知识：不按'经史子集'的藏书结构组织所学，而按'天下病在何处'的问题结构组织——学问的目录是问题的目录
在'用'的现场检验所学：佐命幕中每一条学问都要过'当下可用否'的筛子——不能落到行动的知识转为著述（寓言、文章）而不是堆进决策
以著述回收'用不掉'的学问：郁离子、诗文集是致用之学的储藏层——当下无处用的洞见写下来留给后世用，博学在两个时间尺度上都服务致用
process_en: Register a 'use' for every field of knowledge: astronomy for calendar and timing, strategy for campaigns, classical doctrine for judging policy — learning without a registered use does not make the core curriculum

Reorganize knowledge around problems, not categories: not the bibliographic order of classics-history-philosophy-collections but the problem structure of 'where does the world hurt' — the catalogue of learning is the catalogue of problems

Test learning in the arena of use: in the strategist's tent every item of knowledge passed the sieve of 'usable now' — what could not become action was converted into writing (allegory, essays), never stockpiled into decisions

Recycle unused learning into writing: the Yulizi and the collected poems are the storage tier of practical learning — insights with no present use are written down for later generations, so erudition serves use on two timescales
representative_cases_zh: 以《春秋》义法断军政大事：经学不是书斋课业而是决策语言——'春秋明经'直接成为幕中论政的格式
象纬之学被压缩进两个用途（历法与时机）：占候的全部繁复只为服务两个决策场景——知识为用途所裁剪
弃官著《郁离子》：仕元不能用所学则转为著述——'用'的现场失败时，知识转入储藏层而非废弃
representative_cases_en: Spring-and-Autumn doctrine used to judge military and civil affairs: classical learning as a decision language, not a study — 'clear classics' became the very format of counsel at headquarters
The astral arts compressed into two uses (calendar and timing): all their complexity pruned to serve two decision scenes — knowledge trimmed by use
Leaving office to write the Yulizi: when Yuan service gave his learning no arena, it converted to writing — when the arena of use fails, knowledge passes to the storage tier rather than to waste
modern_applications_zh: 个人知识库的'用途登记'：每学一门先回答'能用来解决什么'，答不出的降级为爱好——以用定学
组织学习的'问题目录'：培训与阅读围绕当前问题清单组织，而非按学科或书单——学问的目录是问题的目录
写作作为知识回收层：当下用不上的洞见写成文章留给未来——博学与致用在两个时间尺度上兼得
modern_applications_en: Use-registration in personal knowledge bases: before learning a field, answer 'what problem does it solve'; if none, demote it to hobby — learning sized by use
Problem catalogues for organizational learning: training and reading organized around the current problem list, not disciplines or book lists — the catalogue of learning is the catalogue of problems
Writing as the recycling tier of knowledge: insights with no present use become essays for the future — erudition and usefulness reconciled across two timescales

王安石（对照：同倡经世，一个以变法致用、一个以幕略致用）
顾炎武（传承：明末实学'经世致用'的直接先驱谱系）
陈亮（上游：浙东事功之学'义利双行'的先声）

modes.domain_zh: 为'当下无法兑现的判断'预设未来的读者：预言诗《烧饼歌》式的身后流传、《郁离子》'以待知者'的著述姿态、临终献书——把自己的思想押注在'后世知者'身上，用作品的时间尺度对冲个人命运的时间尺度
modes.domain_en: Pre-arrange future readers for judgments the present cannot cash: the posthumous circulation of prophecy (the Baked-Cake Song), the Yulizi's posture of 'awaiting the knower', the deathbed presentation of books — staking one's thought on 'knowers in later ages', hedging the timescale of one's fate against the timescale of one's work
modes.source_chapter: 《郁离子》'以待知者'的自期；《诚意伯文集》的身后结集；烧饼歌托名流传的传播学
modes.key_quote_zh: 吾之言，非以媚世也，以待后世之知者
modes.key_quote_en: 'My words flatter no age; I set them down to await the knowers of later generations.'
process_zh: 承认当下市场可能错价：最深的判断往往在当下既不可言说也无人愿买——把'不被理解'当作默认状态来设计
选文体即选读者：寓言给同代的士人，预言诗给民间的传播链条，文章结集给后世的学者——每个文体是一条通向不同'知者'群的管道
作品自带'重审指令'：留下可被后世验证的断言与待解的符号（烧饼歌的隐语、郁离子的意象系统）——让每一代人都有重新打开它的理由
以身后尺度对冲身前命运：个人的荣辱随王朝起落，作品的估值随读者累积——把人生的时间轴放在作品的时间轴里投资
process_en: Concede the present market may misprice: the deepest judgments are often both unspeakable and unbuyable now — design on 'being misunderstood' as the default

Choosing the genre is choosing the reader: allegory for one's contemporaries among the literati, prophecy for the folk channels of circulation, collected writings for scholars of later ages — each genre is a pipe to a different community of knowers

Build a 're-examination command' into the work: leave assertions later ages can verify and symbols left to be solved (the veiled language of the Baked-Cake Song, the image system of the Yulizi) — give every generation a reason to reopen it
Hedge one's fate against one's work: personal honor rises and falls with dynasties; a work's valuation compounds with readers — invest the timeline of a life inside the timeline of the work
representative_cases_zh: 《郁离子》自序'以待知者'：元末写成、明初无人问津，直至身后被推为'诚意伯之学'的源头——寓言体是为两百年后的读者写的
《烧饼歌》托名流传：预言文体自带'代代重解'的传播机制——无论真伪，其符号系统确实驱动了六百年的重新打开
临终以《天文书》献御并诫子孙'习之'：把最敏感的知识同时交付权力（献御）与血脉（诫子）——身后托世走的是双通道
representative_cases_en: The Yulizi's own preface 'awaiting the knower': written at Yuan's end, ignored in the early Ming, honored only after death as the spring of 'the learning of the Earl of Cheng' — allegory written for readers two centuries on
The Baked-Cake Song circulating under his name: the prophetic genre carries its own mechanism of 're-read by every generation' — genuine or not, its symbol system did drive six centuries of reopening

On his deathbed presenting the Book of Celestial Patterns to the throne while charging his sons to study it: the most sensitive knowledge delivered on twin channels, to power and to blood — posthumous trust runs on two tracks
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目的'以待知者'：为当下没人用而设计的系统，留好可验证的断言与待解的接口——让每代开发者都有重开的理由
长周期写作策略：把当下不被理解的判断写成'自带重审指令'的作品——用作品的时间尺度对冲个人声誉的波动
知识遗产设计：临终前的'献御'与'诫子'双通道——重要的个人知识同时安排制度化传承与家族传承
modern_applications_en: 'Awaiting the knower' in open source: build for a present with no users, leaving verifiable claims and unsolved interfaces — give every generation of developers a reason to reopen
Long-cycle writing strategy: cast judgments the present cannot grasp as works with 'built-in re-examination commands' — hedge personal reputation's volatility against the work's timescale
Designing an intellectual legacy: the deathbed twin channels of 'presenting to the throne' and 'charging the sons' — vital personal knowledge arranged for both institutional and familial transmission
